完整保留原始画质，文件体积较大。: Preserves 100% of image quality, resulting in a larger file.
移除拍摄时间、相机型号与地理位置等隐私信息。: Removes date, camera details, and GPS location data.
图像分辨率过高，当前可用内存不足以载入。: This image exceeds available memory and cannot be opened.
图像尺寸超出该格式的上限，未能保存。当前编辑仍完整保留在此窗口中。: Dimensions exceed the limits of this format. Your edits remain in this window.
仅更新方向元数据，不重新编码像素，画质零损耗。: Updates orientation metadata without re-encoding pixels. Zero quality loss.
JPEG 不支持透明通道，透明区域将填充为白色。: JPEG does not support transparency. Transparent areas will be filled with white.
目标格式为静态图像，仅导出当前画面帧。: This format does not support animation. Only the current frame will be saved.
目标格式不支持多页，仅导出当前页。: This format is single-page only. Only the current page will be saved.
目标格式仅支持单一尺寸，将按当前分辨率导出。: This format holds a single resolution. Only the current size will be saved.
GIF 格式上限为 256 色，导出后可能出现色彩断层。: GIF is limited to 256 colors, which may reduce color fidelity.
原图色深超过 8-bit，导出后将收敛为每通道 8-bit。: The source image exceeds 8 bits per channel and will be converted to 8-bit.
目标格式不支持保存拍摄元数据（EXIF）。: This format does not support EXIF photo metadata.
目标格式不支持内嵌色彩配置文件，色彩空间将转换为标准 sRGB。: This format doesn't embed color profiles. Colors will be converted to standard sRGB.
